1015.description: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and wrap the band around a sturdy object at chest height.
Hold the band with both hands and step away from the anchor point, creating tension in the band.
Position yourself perpendicular to the anchor point, with your side facing the band.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your hands at chest height.
Engage your core and press the band away from your chest, fully extending your arms.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then slowly bring the band back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带缠绕在胸部高度的坚固物体上。
用双手握住弹力带并远离锚点，在弹力带中产生张力。
使自己垂直于锚点，一侧面向弹力带。
将双臂伸直在身前，保持双手与胸同高。
收紧核心肌群，将弹力带压离胸部，充分伸展手臂。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢将弹力带拉回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1079.description: Hip hinge back extension with feet in straps. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

1143.description: A bodyweight squat where you hold the straps for balance and can lean back for depth.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

1207.description: A diagonal cable rotation from low to high that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
instructions: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1271.description: A stretch for the chest and the fronts of the shoulders with the hands clasped. It loosens the chest.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Cross your arms in front of your body, with your right arm on top of your left arm.
Interlace your fingers and press your palms together.
Gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your hands forward, feeling a stretch in your chest and front of your shoulders.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉并将手掌压在一起。
轻轻地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，然后将双手向前推，感觉胸部和肩膀前部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
重复所需的重复次数。

1335.description: A back extension on a stability ball with your legs braced so your knees stay off the ground. It works the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Position your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙上以保持稳定。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1399.description: With your hands on a bench behind you and your feet on the floor, you bend and straighten your elbows. It builds the triceps, chest and shoulders.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1463.description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled, shown from the side. It loads the quads and glutes with your back supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the sled machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the sled machine with your back flat against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push against the footplate to extend your legs, straightening them completely.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly bend your knees to lower the footplate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整雪橇机的座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖呈90度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部平放在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
握住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
推动脚踏板以伸展双腿，将其完全伸直。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢弯曲膝盖，将踏板放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1527.description: A deep, upright high-bar squat in the weightlifting style. It builds leg strength and mobility.
instructions: Place the bar high on your upper back and set your feet about shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit straight down as deep as you can with heels flat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

1591.description: An explosive single-leg push off the floor or a step. It builds leg drive useful for running and jumping.
instructions: Stand in front of a low step with one foot planted on it.
Lean slightly forward and keep your core tight.
Push off the step explosively with that leg and drive your opposite knee up.
Land softly on the same foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

1655.description: A squat combined with a dumbbell curl. It works the legs and biceps in one move.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Keeping your back straight and your elbows close to your sides, exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近身体两侧，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1719.description: A close grip bench press on an incline. It targets the triceps and the upper chest.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1783.description: Holding a wall bar and turning away from it stretches your chest and shoulder. The bars let you pick the exact height that suits you.
instructions: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1911.description: A hamstring stretch with one leg raised onto a support, easing tension in the back of the thigh.
instructions: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1975.description: A seated stretch that lengthens the shoulder and chest by pressing the arms back and down.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Place your hands behind you on the seat, fingers pointing back.
Press your shoulders down and back, opening your chest.
Lean slightly forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

2103.description: Spreads the toes apart to wake up and loosen the small muscles of the foot.
instructions: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
Hold the spread for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch feet.

2359.description: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2423.description: A floor back extension with band resistance for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down and anchor a band under your hands or around your upper back.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without overarching.

2487.description: A bent-over fly that targets the rear of the shoulders.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells below your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your neck neutral.

2743.description: A machine hip thrust that loads the glutes in a controlled path.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Secure the hip pad over your lap.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control without letting the weight crash.

2807.description: A wide stance hinge where a dumbbell swings between the legs. Trains glutes, inner thighs and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall, swinging the dumbbell to hip height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

2871.description: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

2935.description: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

2999.description: A calf and Achilles stretch with a band that gently pulls the toes toward you while the leg is behind you.
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.

3127.description: Turning the sole of the foot outward against a band to train the muscles on the outer side of the ankle.
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3319.description: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

3383.description: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

3511.description: A bird dog with a band for extra resistance, training the lower back, glutes and core stability.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

3575.description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell, friendly on the knees while building glutes and thighs.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

3639.description: A lying twist with the knees bent, lowering them to each side. It loosens the lower back and hips.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your knees.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and slowly lift your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体垂直。
保持膝盖并拢，慢慢地将它们降低到一侧，旨在用膝盖接触地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并慢慢将膝盖抬回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3703.description: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.
instructions: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.

3767.description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell for balance and extra load.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3831.description: Lying on your back, you curl a towel looped around one foot with an overhand grip. It targets your forearms and biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around one foot.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward you while the foot resists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

3959.description: Walk forward in a front plank, stepping hands and feet to challenge the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand forward, then the other.
Follow with your feet.
Keep your hips level.
Walk forward a few steps, then back.

4023.description: A forearm or high plank where you reach a foot out to tap the floor. It trains core stability and hip control.
instructions: Start in a front plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot and tap the toes out to the side without twisting your hips.
Bring the foot back to the start.
Repeat on the other leg and keep alternating.

4087.description: A band curl with your arms angled about 45 degrees behind your body, which stretches the biceps and works the long head.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, then set your arms about 45 degrees behind your torso.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Curl your hands up while your upper arms stay in that angled position.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.
Avoid leaning back to finish the rep.

4151.description: A triceps extension lying on the floor, bending only at the elbows. The floor limits the range and keeps tension on the triceps.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and avoid flaring them.

4215.description: A one-arm version of the plate-loaded low row. Working one side at a time helps fix strength differences in your back.
instructions: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended and shoulder relaxed forward.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4279.description: A seated stretch that opens up the front of the torso and abs. It leaves your midsection feeling long and loose.
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your legs together.
Place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest and straightening your arms.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and relax.

4343.description: A single-arm overhead extension with a dumbbell. It isolates the triceps and builds arm strength.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4407.description: A triceps exercise using a bodyweight or stick-style handle, focused on straightening the elbows against resistance.
instructions: Set up facing your anchor or support, with your upper arms close to your body.
Brace your core and keep your elbows still.
Straighten your arms fully to engage the triceps.
Squeeze at the bottom for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

4471.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front outer hip (tensor fasciae latae). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front outer hip (tensor fasciae latae) while lying on your side.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4535.description: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4599.description: A roller or ball release for the deep hip flexor area at the front of the pelvis.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone.
Support your weight on your forearms.
Shift your weight gently over the roller.
Roll slowly a small distance up and down.
Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

4663.description: Lifting your arms behind you from a face-down position. It strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4727.description: A basic crunch with your arms crossed over your chest. It trains the abs without pulling on the neck.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4791.description: A one-legged glute bridge with arms crossed on the chest. It focuses the work on the glutes and tests hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4855.description: A standing trunk rotation without load. It warms up the obliques and spine.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips facing forward.

4919.description: A kneeling, assisted chin up where you slide on the floor to reduce the load. It helps you build toward full chin ups.
instructions: Kneel below a bar and grab it with an underhand grip.
Place a towel or slider under your knees.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs lightly to help.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

4983.description: Holding the top of a pull-up with your chin above the bar. It builds strength and grip in the finish position.
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar and pull yourself up.
Bring your chin above the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower yourself slowly.
Keep your body still.

5047.description: Side plank with the knees bent for a gentler version. It builds the obliques and hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

5239.description: Sitting on a stability ball, you curl a dumbbell and then press it overhead into an extension. It works both arms muscles and trunk balance.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up with your elbow at your side.
Raise it overhead, lifting it with both hands.
Lower it behind your head for a triceps extension.
Extend, return to the front, and repeat.

5303.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides on an incline of about 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang below you with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging.

5623.description: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.

5815.description: A single-arm press on a chest press machine. Training one side at a time helps balance strength between arms.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip one handle at chest level.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your set.

5879.description: A side plank holding a kettlebell above you. It builds core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

5943.description: A one-arm cable front raise with a palm-in grip, giving steady tension to the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

6007.description: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

6071.description: A vertical pull with bottles toward your chest. It works the shoulders and traps.
instructions: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.

6263.description: A standing wrist curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearm extensors.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Extend your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

6327.description: A split squat with a deep, low range that challenges your front thigh and glutes while building balance and hip mobility.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

6775.description: A standing drill that wakes up the small muscles of the feet. It builds foot control and balance.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.

7287.description: Overhead press using a trap bar, giving a neutral grip that can be easier on the shoulders.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

7415.description: Dip with a leaning body angle that loads the shoulders and triceps hard.
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

7543.description: A light hop forward and back that builds ankle spring and coordination.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.

8311.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

8375.description: A plate-loaded angled press that works the thighs and glutes with a stable seated position.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees out.

10551.description: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

10743.description: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

10871.description: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

10935.description: Using a stick to guide the arm out and back behind you. It improves shoulder range.
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back.
Hold it with one hand low and the other high.
Use the low hand to guide the top arm out and up.
Move only in a comfortable range.
Return slowly and switch sides.

11255.description: A side lunge with cable resistance. It builds strength in your hips and thighs through a sideways step.
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your chest.
Step wide to the side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11383.description: Stretches the muscles on top of the forearm that lift the wrist. Good after typing, climbing or heavy gripping.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

0055.description: A close-grip press from a lying position. Targets the triceps with chest involvement.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing towards your feet.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest, then push it back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
紧紧握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，手掌朝向脚部。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃接触胸部时暂停片刻，然后将其推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0119.description: An upright row with the barbell pulled toward the chin. Works the delts and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，呼气，将杠铃向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0183.description: A biceps curl lying on your back with a low cable. The position keeps your body steady and your arms isolated.
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your head toward a low pulley and take the bar overhead.
Start with your arms extended.
Curl the bar toward your forehead or chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower with control to full extension.
Keep your elbows pointing upward and your back flat.

0247.description: A cable wrist curl with the forearms resting on a pad. It builds the muscles on the palm side of the forearm.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on a bench or pad, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
将前臂放在长凳或垫子上，手腕悬在边缘上。
保持前臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0311.description: A lateral raise with the thumbs up, as if holding full cans. It works the side delts and the rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0375.description: Lying across or along a bench, you lower one dumbbell behind your head and pull it back over your chest. It works the chest and lats with a deep stretch.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，直到感觉胸部和肩膀有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0439.description: You curl up with palms up, rotate the palms down, and lower slowly. It works the biceps on the way up and the forearms on the way down.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing away from your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your palms back to facing your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌以面向前方。
将哑铃举至肩膀处，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点，旋转手腕，使手掌背向身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，将手掌旋转回面向身体。
重复所需的重复次数。

0503.description: From a plank with shins on a ball, you pike your hips up high. It hits the abs and challenges balance and shoulder stability.
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your shins or feet resting on a stability ball.
Keep your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Roll the ball toward your hands as you lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Keep your legs fairly straight and pull with your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Roll the ball back out to the plank without sagging your lower back.

0567.description: A box jump with a twist in the air that adds rotation. It builds explosive leg power and trunk control.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and rotate your hips to land sideways on the box.
Land softly with bent knees.
Step down and reset.
Alternate the twist direction each rep.

0631.description: You pull yourself above a bar and then press up into a dip position. Trains the lats, chest and arms in a powerful transition.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is above the bar and your arms are fully flexed.
Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续将自己向上拉，直到胸部位于杠铃上方并且手臂完全弯曲。
通过慢慢降低自己回到起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

0759.description: On an incline setup, you raise the smith machine bar in front of you. Works the front shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to an incline position.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the barbell up towards the ceiling, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机调整至倾斜位置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃举向天花板，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0823.description: A crunch with straight arms reaching across to the side. It focuses on the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms extended toward the ceiling.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach your straight arms toward one side of your knees.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides, keeping your neck relaxed.

0951.description: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
